title: Securing financial transactions: lightweight blockchain-enabled deep learning for fraud detection in fintech systems
core_idea: Combine lightweight blockchain to provide immutable, transparent, tamper-proof transaction records with deep learning models for dynamic anomaly detection, targeting real-time, scalable, and energy-efficient fraud detection in resource-constrained fintech environments (e.g., mobile and IoT) while preserving data integrity and trust.
tldr: Propose integrating lightweight blockchain and deep learning to enable adaptive, scalable, and real-time fraud detection in financial transactions without heavy computational or storage overhead.
